rubric.reason: Success criteria claim detection of all five holes while the MVP check set covers four. Key Hypothesis says "detects all five known holes on the current tree" and Success Metrics targets "5 / 5"; but MoSCoW lists ".sh/.ps1 parity check + fix hole #5" as a Could with "no A-G check covers it", the same metric's measurement hedges "count distinct checks firing on holes #1-#4 (plus #5 if a parity check ships)", and AC-2 defines green as "a tree with holes #1-#4 fixed". The success claim (5) exceeds MVP capability (4).
